record.body:
## Rationale

The 60-column footer fits seven hints. Adding "n needs" pushed one out; enter is the most guessable key, works everywhere a row is selected, and stays in the README key table.

## Counter-argument

New users read the footer, not the README; without "open" nothing on screen says that enter opens a task.

payload.alternatives: hide copy, hide phase, drop n from the footer
payload.choice: Hide the enter open hint from the footer so n needs fits at 60 columns

record.subject: footer-hides-open
